description.en: Password-protected LAN access to the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
description.zh: 通过密码登录，让局域网内的其他设备访问 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面。

description.en: Exposes the DeepSeek Harness web GUI to other devices on the local network through a password-protected HTTP/WebSocket reverse proxy. Sessions are revoked whenever the access password changes.
description.zh: 通过带密码保护的 HTTP/WebSocket 反向代理，让局域网内的手机、平板和其他电脑访问 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面；修改密码后旧设备会话立即失效。
